title: How to Start a Manual Car on a Hill Without Rolling
hook: Stop rolling backward on steep hills.

script.narration: Stop rolling backward on steep hills.
script.visual_search: driver pulling manual car handbrake on steep street

script.narration: First, pull your handbrake firmly to hold the car in place.
script.visual_search: close up of hand pulling car handbrake lever

script.narration: Next, slowly release the clutch until you feel the engine bite.
script.visual_search: driver foot pressing clutch pedal inside car

script.narration: Finally, drop the handbrake as you accelerate smoothly forward.
script.visual_search: car driving forward smoothly up a hill view

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you drive manual? Comment yes or no, because you must stop rolling backward on steep hills.
script.visual_search: rear view of car driving up steep city hill

description:
Master starting a manual transmission car on a steep hill using the handbrake method. Learn these essential driving tips for beginners to prevent rolling backward and stalling.

Keep your car safe and controlled in traffic with these quick driving tips and tricks.
